scope: Generic retention sweeper now supports exact direct-column scope predicates for configured location, jurisdiction, and purpose values. It does not choose policy periods or infer domain relationships.

implementation.sql_identifiers: Fixed code-owned column mapping; all scope values are bound parameters.
implementation.retention_period_defaults: None added; configured values remain operator-owned policy data.
implementation.destructive_gate: Unchanged; explicit enforcement feature gate, approved metadata, positive window, and exact legal-hold checks remain required.

limitations: Scoped policies require the target table itself to expose the direct scope column. No country-name translation or parent-table join is inferred.
